Angbak already said this, but Imma repeat. Soulforges levels are SUPER important in Arc 2 as they provide more base stats (Defense/Hp/Attack) hence they are basically “Levels” but use different resources. More Defense and Hp overall reduces the damage taken and how quick you die, even if Ryker/Hameln/Ramona’s Attack doesnt matter. Ofc, Soulforges give additional abilities/effects as well in the form of more damage or survivability or utility if XYZ. In D-Tide(Another game mode), and other sources(sometimes from time to time) give “Pyramids” which allows “Limit Breaking” units above 60 to 70. Your skills are all low level which makes your acceleration a tad slower(Aliemus/Keyflare/STR). If you are a couple turns off from clearing often, consider looking into “Burial Grounds” Cov Set for DR(Death Res). You can put that set on Hameln and/or Ryker. You can maximize on Death Res on those two(but keep Saya Sig). 

Other than that, the rest are more specifics about Cetarchon Comp so Angbak advice is solid and much more knowledgable.
